title: A "claim tornado" page named for another member
summary: On Sat 14 Nov at 21:10Z @dave.9000ish.uk (880 followers) posted a video with the words "it's a claim tornado"; its alt text is "a norvid claim tornado". It has 30 likes. The next morning the same account quote-posted it with "Let the claims wash over you" and a link to claims.9000ish.uk, whose page title is "Norvid Claim Tornado". @norvid-studies.bsky.social replied with an image. The same maker made the polyhedral coffee simulator three days later (see made-polyhedral-coffee-simulator).

made.what: a page titled "Norvid Claim Tornado", and a video of it

couldBeShown: Research does not know. The video's alt text is five words and the page is described only by its title; presumably many instances of the word "claim", or of the posts it was attached to, moving as a tornado.
numbers: 30 likes and 2 reposts on the video; 13 likes on the link.
10 h 36 min between the video (Sat 21:10Z) and the link (Sun 07:46Z).

posts.note: The video. Top-level. The alt text is the maker's.

posts.text:
Let the claims wash over you

claims.9000ish.uk
posts.note: The link. Quotes the video post.

people.role: the member whose posts it is made from

sensitive: The page is named for another member (the video's alt text is "a norvid claim tornado"); research assumes, without having seen it, that it is built from that member's "claim" posts. @norvid-studies.bsky.social is marked featuredPrevious: spoke, so the account is not cast to speak in this episode; its posts may be shown. That account's reply to the link is an image with no text and no alt text, so its reaction is not known to research; without it there is no evidence in the data of how the subject took it, beyond the two being frequent, friendly correspondents all week. The word "claim" is a habit of that account's that other members imitate; whether the show has used it before is for the reviewers. A related idea by another member, a browser extension for making such posts, sits in the story the digest withholds because a post in it asks not to be quoted; it is not carried and not described here.
notUnderstood: What "claim" means when that account posts it.
